subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat's unresumable restart-recovery notice be stored as a persistent delivery-mirror transcript row when there is no deliverable outbound channel?
rationale: The code path is a plausible narrow bug fix, but it defines a persistent session-history representation for failed recovery notices and overlaps adjacent restart-recovery storage design.
